item.title: Twitch's CEO puts a date on GTA 6's online mode, and it's not the one you expected
item.description: Dan Clancy, Twitch's top executive, suggested GTA 6's multiplayer mode could arrive in 2027, a full year after the main game's launch.

item.title: Court documents confirm what we suspected: Rockstar is working on a 32-player online mode for GTA 6
item.description: Documents filed in an employment tribunal reveal Rockstar internally discussed a "confidential 32-player online format" for GTA 6, updating our previous theory on the future of the online mode.

item.title: Rockstar's silence on the new GTA Online isn't an oversight: it might be the smartest move they could make
item.description: A specialized journalist theorizes the new GTA 6 online mode could take years to arrive. We break down why this makes more sense than it seems at first glance.
